name: 1.23.0-beta.35
notes: Big games (pictures loaded when needed): a picture still on its way no longer flashes blue for a moment, in the game or in the fix tools. The stand-in Ren'Py shows until a picture arrives is now see-through instead of blue.
The pictures in the fix tools (choices, parts of a layered picture, Preview) are drawn again once the pictures they need have arrived, so they are never shown with stand-ins.
